items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Cook, the band master, hit me over my head with a baton.

ctx.x: WHAT OPPORTUNITIES DID YOU HAVE TO PLAY WHEN YOU WRE IN SCHOOL? DID YOU HAVE MUCH OPPORTUNITY TO PLAY OTHER THAN PRACTICE OR WERE YOU PLAYING TYPICAL SCHOOL...

Well, we were playing typical band music. I never forget a time that I put a couple of extra notes in this band music and Mr. Cook, the band master, hit me over my head with a baton. I shall never forget that. But, I always wanted to be what we call swing. I always wanted to do that.
YOU DIDN'T HAVE TO MUCH FEAR OUT OF COMING OUT OF LITTLE ROCK; DID YOU?
